# FDG5063

> DO NOT pass `null` as the event data parameter when raising an event.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.4 Event Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG5063
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Message: Do not pass null as the event data when raising the event '{0}'

FDG5063 reports a call that raises a field-like event directly (Event(...) or Event?.Invoke(...)) with a constant null as the second argument, when the event's delegate takes an EventArgs or a subclass second. An event raised through a local copy of the delegate is not seen, nor a null passed through a variable. The fix changes a call, not a signature; there is no code fix.

## From the book

You should pass `EventArgs.Empty` if you don’t want to pass any data to the event handling method. Developers expect this parameter not to be `null`.
